findings.title: Correct the SQLite rationale for zero limits.
findings.rationale: LIMIT 0 returns no rows, while a negative LIMIT means no limit. Keep rejecting zero if that is the API contract, but revise the docstring so it does not apply the “no limit” behavior to every non-positive value.
